title: UNIT 9
sourcePolicy: Full supplied audio, same order and tempo, no added dialogue, gain change, or music. Machine transcription is timing evidence, not burned captions.
creativePremise: One operator tries to restore a human connection while a nine-panel system takes control. The open connection is a question, never a demonstrated solution.
timingPolicy: Narration phrase changes choose subjects and cuts. Selected strong onset candidates choose physical endpoints. Instrumental hits use the earlier bass/flux analysis where the mixed-track librosa detector returns no onset. No uniform beat-grid cutting.
transcriptCaution: Opening and repeated critical-alert wording remain uncertain; the raw machine transcript is not burned into the picture.
